name: StepProgress
purpose: Where the user is in a short run of steps, such as a funnel: one segment per step up to eight, else a track with a count, on a dark glass capsule in the navigation layer.
accessibility: Not a control. One VoiceOver element that reads the label the caller gives, for example "Step 2 of 4". The count in the track variant stops growing at XXXL. Under Reduce Transparency the glass becomes a solid dark ground; under Reduce Motion the fill doesn't animate.
